help-flag.stdout:
usage: wt [-h]
          {init,add,a,remove,rm,status,st,fetch,f,pull,p,list,ls,upstream,up,prune} ...

Git worktree management CLI - manage multiple worktrees from anywhere

positional arguments:
  {init,add,a,remove,rm,status,st,fetch,f,pull,p,list,ls,upstream,up,prune}
                        Available commands
    init                Initialize a new bare repository with worktree
                        structure
    add (a)             Add a new worktree
    remove (rm)         Remove a worktree (keeps local branch unless -b)
    status (st)         Show status of all worktrees
    fetch (f)           Fetch all remotes (git fetch --all --prune)
    pull (p)            Fetch and sync all worktrees
    list (ls)           List all worktrees
    upstream (up)       Set upstream to origin/<branch> for all worktrees
    prune               Remove stale worktree references

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
